Is the proposed airworthiness directive for Sikorsky S-92A helicopters under docket FAA-2010-0720, which would reduce the main gearbox housing life limit, still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM in a notice issued 2021-01-25 (doc 2021-05194). The original proposal was published 2010-07-13. It would have required revising the airworthiness limitations to reduce the main gearbox housing life limit and replacing any housing that exceeded it. The withdrawal is the latest entry, and no final rule resulted from this NPRM.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2005-23007 for Airbus A310-200 and -300 series airplanes (inspections behind the scuff plates below the doors) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The FAA published the NPRM on 2005-11-09, proposing repetitive inspections for cracks and corrosion behind the scuff plates below the passenger/crew doors and bulk cargo door. On 2006-07-14 the FAA withdrew that NPRM. The withdrawal notice is the latest entry, so there is no open comment period and no final rule came from this docket entry.

query: What is the current status of the proposed AD under docket 2002-NM-352-AD requiring replacement of air turbine starters on EMBRAER EMB-135 and -145 airplanes? Is it still active or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM issued 2003-12-10 would have required replacing the air turbine starters with modified ATSs on certain EMBRAER EMB-135 and -145 series airplanes. On 2005-04-11 the FAA withdrew it after reviewing the proposed requirements. No final rule resulted from this docket entry, and there is no open comment period.

query: What is the current status of the FAA proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2021-1017 covering True Flight Holdings LLC Model AA-1, AA-1A, AA-1B, AA-1C, AA-5, AA-5A, and AA-5B airplanes? Is it still open for comment or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM in a notice issued 2022-04-07 (doc 2022-07871). The NPRM would have required inspections of the wings, fuselage, and related structure after an accident involving bondline corrosion and delamination of the horizontal stabilizers. Because it was withdrawn, no final AD will be issued from it and there is no open comment deadline.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2017-0492 requiring an EGPWS software update on rotorcraft with Honeywell EGPWS still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM issued 2017-05-15 (doc 2017-11174) was withdrawn by the FAA in a notice issued 2020-05-28 (doc 2020-11848), so the proposed AD will not be adopted and there is no open comment deadline.

query: What is the current status of the proposed AD under docket FAA-2015-0868 covering Lycoming engines fitted with Superior Air Parts piston pins (P/N 13444-1)? Is it still an active proposal or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. In document 2015-09535, issued 2015-04-15, the FAA withdrew the NPRM that would have required removal of defective Superior Air Parts piston pins (P/N 13444-1) on certain Lycoming engines. It is the only and latest entry in the docket, and no comment deadline remains open.
